classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round every rank hits `barrier.wait()` and then all read the same shared `class_a(workdir, r, placing)` file with `_read_staged` before the next barrier, so the whole job is held at the synchronisation point until that one file's open/fstat/pread completes, and each per-round path `m%d` is read exactly once by a rank.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: After the barrier each rank synchronously `_read(class_b(workdir, me, i), ...)` on its own private files while other ranks read theirs, and the loop `for r in range(cell.rounds)` re-reads each of the rank's 2 class_b files once per round (200 reads of a single file).

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: Each rank blocks on its own `_read(class_c(workdir, me, i, placing), ...)` calls outside any barrier, and the same per-rank file index is re-read on every one of the 200 rounds.
